title: 📹 From a different parade of women with FPV micro-drones to a major destruction
text:
📹 From a different parade of women with FPV micro-drones to a major destruction"

"🔺For the first time in the military history of the IRGC Ground Forces, Iranian lionesses took command of piloting ultra-advanced FPV micro-drones in the Parade of Authority. But this was not just a display!"

"🔺In this modern operation, the women were responsible for reconnaissance, and the men, using suicide drones, delivered the final blow and the complete destruction of the building. A combination of intelligence, technology, and courage!
